title: Sheinbaum Is Already on Her Way to Shenzhen, China, to Attend the APEC Summit
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by[La Jornada Editorial
Staff](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [November 15, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/15/politica/sheinbaum-ya-
viaja-rumbo-a-shenzhen-china-para-acudir-a-la-cumbre-apec), Mexico's premier
left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** President [Claudia
Sheinbaum](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/13/politica/sheinbaum-
defendera-ante-apec-la-vision-del-bienestar-comun-la-soberania-y-la-
cooperacion-para-el-desarrollo) Pardo reported that she is traveling to
Shenzhen, China, where she will take part in the leaders’ summit of the Asia-
Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum.

On social media, the head of the executive branch posted a video in which she
explains that she will first attend a meeting with business leaders from the
member nations of that multilateral forum and will also take part in a meeting
of government cabinets.

> [Post by @Claudiashein on
> X](https://twitter.com/Claudiashein/status/2121965793558634840)

A day later, she said, she will join the
[APEC](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/14/economia/enfrentamiento-
entre-grandes-potencias-redefine-la-logica-de-la-economia-mundial) heads-of-
state summit.

In the video, recorded at Mexico City International Airport before boarding,
as she traveled on a commercial airline, the president noted that she will
connect to the morning press conferences from China to give details of the
working trip.

> “We are traveling to Shenzhen to represent Mexico at the Asia-Pacific
> Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum, China 2026; the schedule of activities
> includes a meeting with business leaders from member countries. In addition,
> I will take part in the morning press conference to report on the progress
> of this international meeting.”

APEC was founded in 1989, and Mexico is one of its three Latin American member
countries. Its main purpose is to promote economic growth, technical
cooperation and the liberalization of trade and investment among the economies
of the Pacific region.
